title: Mediocre
text:
Mediocre. It works but it's kind of a pain ... doesn't like to catch the can to cut and the magnet is useless. I still have to maneuver the lid off and cut my finger the first time.

I like it, but definitely not worth 5 stars as I'll probably replace it sooner than I would have preferred.
